prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 55px · one-line width 172px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 74px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 87px · one-line width 545px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 81px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 467px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 466px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较主流旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、显示技术与价格。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向查看同一款手机的屏幕和价格；也会纵向比较尺寸、技术和价格。技术描述较长，通常决定行高，可利用这些行高容纳型号换行。","groups":["屏幕尺寸与屏幕技术同属“屏幕”表头，分别用于快速比较尺寸和阅读具体技术配置。","型号是行标识，价格是独立的比较指标；两者需要便于沿列扫描。"],"keep_intact":["手机型号中的品牌、系列和型号标识应尽量完整，避免在标识内部断行。","屏幕尺寸数值与“英寸”应尽量放在一起。","价格数值及其货币单位应尽量保持完整。","屏幕技术中的 OLED、AMOLED、LTPO、120Hz 等缩写和数值应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术描述可在技术名称、特性和标点之间自然换行。","较长型号可在品牌与系列名称之间换行，并利用技术描述形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [193, 80, 120, 73] · table 467×1159px · row heights [39, 39, 197, 145, 171, 171, 197, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [145, 85, 155, 81] · table 467×922px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [120, 75, 205, 66] · table 467×711px · row heights [39, 39, 118, 92, 92, 92, 118, 118] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"型号列宽充裕，所有型号保持单行，便于按行定位；表头层级清楚。","problems":"技术描述被挤成大量短行，行高过大，型号列出现大片空白；尺寸单位和价格也分行，跨行比较费力。","cause":"型号列193px占用过多宽度，技术列仅120px；尺寸列80px和价格列73px也不足以容纳最长内容。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"技术列加宽后，行高明显降低；多数型号仍完整或在可理解的位置换行，表头清晰。","problems":"技术描述仍有较多短行，部分型号换行不够理想；多数尺寸的“英寸”和所有价格的单位分行，影响纵向扫描。","cause":"技术列155px仍偏窄；型号列145px不足以容纳最长型号，尺寸列85px和价格列81px不足以容纳最长单行内容。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"技术列宽205px，描述更连贯，行高较紧凑；尺寸与技术的分组关系清楚。","problems":"型号列的换行较频繁，部分品牌与系列被拆开；尺寸和价格普遍分行，数字与单位不易一眼读完。","cause":"为技术列让出宽度后，型号列仅120px、尺寸列75px、价格列66px，均不足以完整容纳各自较长内容。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-units","widths":[120,95,149,102],"change":"将尺寸和价格加宽至各自最长单行内容所需宽度，让数字与单位完整显示；以技术列换取更清晰的指标扫描，型号保留适度换行。"},{"name":"model-priority","widths":[145,95,145,81],"change":"保留r0B较易辨识的型号宽度，并让尺寸完整显示；价格允许换行，检验型号与尺寸优先时技术列的可读性。"},{"name":"technology-priority","widths":[120,95,170,81],"change":"保留r0C的紧凑型号列，优先保证尺寸完整，并给技术描述更多空间；价格允许分行，观察技术阅读与行高的折中。"}]}
